Name: Dark-Haired Leah
Author: Jokerine
Description:
[i][b][center][color=#66CDAA]Do not download this mod from any place other than NexusMods or the Chucklefish forums! [url=http://www.stardewvalleymods.net/]WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET[/url]STEALS MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DO NOT download any mods there! If you see my mods anywhere other than Nexus or the forums, please link me to the site asap. Thank you![/color][/center][/b][/i]
Hey, folks! This mod simply makes Leah's hair a darker color. Portrait and world sprite included.

I was growing tired of all the redheads in this game (nothing personal, of course!) and wanted to give this a go, so here we are. Maybe someone else would like to use it, so I'm sharing it here. I know it's not perfect. I also did a bit of tweaking after I took the pictures to soften the edges a bit.

To install, make a backup of your files and unzip the [font=Courier New]Content [/font]folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley[/font] folder, overwriting everything. If you're using Steam, the location should be[font=Courier New] "Steam\steamapps\Stardew Valley".

[/font]Enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Update to remove the weird dark lines on Leah's mouth and undo some discoloring of the clothes.
